# @skillpet/chat

> SSE streaming AI chat panel component library for React & Vue 3.

## Docs

- [API Reference (Markdown)](https://chat.skill.pet/api.md): Full API documentation for @skillpet/chat-react, @skillpet/chat-vue, and @skillpet/chat-core — types, props, hooks, and usage examples.
